PROVINCIAL COUNCIL OF THE UVA PROVINCE
Ministry of Transportation

REGULATIONS enacted by the Uva Provincial Minister of Sports, Youth Affairs, Tourism, Transport, Cultural Affairs,Textiles and Small Industries in respect of the composition of the Uva Provincial Road Transport Service Authority underSections 5 and 6 of the Statute for Uva Provincial Passenger Transport Service Authority of No. 01 of 2001 and theStatute (amendment) for Uva Provincial Road Transport Service Authority of No. 02 of 2019.
SALIYA SUMEDHA DE SILVA,Minister of Sports, Youth Affairs, Tourism,Transport, Cultural Affairs, Textiles and Small Industries,Uva Provincial Council.
In the Ministry of Sports, Youth Affairs, Tourism,Transport, Cultural Affairs, Textiles and Small Industries,28th August, 2019.
REGULATIONS

1. The Regulations published in the Gazette (Extraordinary) of No. 2108/60 of Thursday, 31st January 2019 of theDemocratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka related to the appointment of the Board of Directors of the UvaProvincial Passenger Transport Service Authority are hereby amended as follows.
2. The appointments of the below mentioned members of the Director Board of the Uva Provincial Road TransportService Authority are hereby cancelled and instead, new members are appointed as follows.
